text:
mia: Quick econ snapshot for GTN on aeon13b-int6 quant bring-up. TL;DR: good quality for chat, ~2.1x cost reduction vs current prod, small latency tail increase. Recommend 10% canary + clear abort criteria.
ajay: Can you paste the numbers? @product-sam FYI.
mia: pasted numbers below — short table and notes.
```
model: aeon13b-int6
avg_tokens_per_request: 350
p50_latency_ms: 95
p95_latency_ms: 240
cost_per_1k_tokens: $0.42
cost_ratio_vs_prod: 0.48  # ~2.1x cheaper than nova-7b-fp16 baseline
quality_delta_intent_f1: -0.9% (10k eval GTN mix)
hallucination_rate_delta: +0.3%
notes: small regression on long-form summarization slices
```
sophia: Where did you run these? dataset + sampling?
mia: Eval was 10k GTN examples (50/50 short/long), traffic-simulated with user prompt priming. Baseline = nova-7b-fp16 (prod).
lennon: Any big regressions by intent or vertical?
mia: Most intents within ±0.5%, a couple low-frequency slots dipped ~2.4% (n=120). We flagged those for prompt tweaks.
product-sam: Hallucination uptick concerning. How actionable is mitigation?
mia: Two mitigations: 1) small prompt engineering fixes for the slices; 2) fallback routing on high hallucination signal. Both seem viable and low-effort.
ajay: What's the econ upside if we push to 50%?
mia: Rough calc: at 50% traffic, token cost down ~1.9x vs prod -> ~40% net infra savings on GTN bill (depends on token mix). I can share a spreadsheet, but ballpark holds.
ops-jordan: I can wire the canary route + alarms. Share exact monitors pls.
mia: Suggested monitors: intent_F1 (rolling 1h), hallucination_rate (alerts at >1% absolute), p95_latency (>300ms alert), error_rate (>0.3%). Abort rule: intent_F1 drop >1.5% OR hallucination >1% sustained 30m.
ops-jordan: config snippet I can use: 
```
routes:
  - name: aeon-canary
    model: aeon13b-int6
    traffic: 0.10
    fallback: nova-7b-fp16
    monitors: [intent_f1, hallucination_rate, p95_latency, error_rate]
    abort_criteria:
      intent_f1_drop_pct: 1.5
      hallucination_abs_pct: 1.0
```
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled and started at 1833333020 :rocket:
sophia: :thumbsup: Good plan. schedule a 24h check-in and include slice breakdown for the 2 low-frequency slots.
mia: Will do — I'll pull slice-level logs + sample failures after 24h and post a follow-up.
product-sam: Thanks team — I'll brief GTN PMs and note the guardrails.
ajay: Add cost alert too (if observed cost per 1k tokens deviates >10% from estimate).
ops-jordan: Will add cost metric to dashboards.
mia: Thanks — posting follow-up window ~1833416620 (24h).
